kp.flag.unknown_or_text: Unknown flag %s. If it is text, put it after a lone -- (everything after -- is text).
kp.flag.repeated: Flag %s was given more than once. Nothing was done.
kp.memory.forget.usage: Usage: /memory forget [--dry-run] <text>  ·  /memory forget [--dry-run] -- <text starting with -->  ·  /memory forget --id <id>   (ids: /memory facts)
kp.memory.forget.id_exclusive: --id removes exactly one fact: it cannot be combined with a text or --dry-run.
kp.memory.forget.id_none: No stored fact has an id starting with %q. /memory facts shows the ids.
kp.memory.forget.id_ambiguous: %d facts have ids starting with %q. Use a longer prefix from /memory facts.
kp.memory.forget.preview: Dry run: %d fact(s) contain %q and would be removed. Nothing was removed — run again without --dry-run, or use --id to remove one:
kp.memory.facts.bad_limit: %q is not a positive number for --limit.
kp.complete.memory.forget_dry_run: Show what would be removed, remove nothing
kp.complete.memory.forget_id: Remove exactly one fact by its id (from /memory facts)
kp.complete.memory.facts_limit: Show at most this many facts
kp.skill.registry.usage: Nothing was changed. Usage: /skill registry enable|disable <name>   (/skill registries lists them)
kp.skill.usage.restore: Usage: /skill restore <name> [--yes]   (without --yes it only shows what would change)
kp.skill.restore.preview: Would overwrite %s with the backup %s, and remove the backup. Nothing was changed. Run /skill restore %s --yes to do it.
kp.skill.other_file: Note: this session loads skill %q from %s; /skill restore acts on a different file, %s.
kp.complete.skill.restore_yes: Perform the restore (without it, only a preview)
kp.session.attach.same: Already bound to session %q — nothing changed.
kp.skill.help.show: Print a skill's content, triggers and location
kp.skill.help.restore: Undo a self-evolved skill: bring back the version saved before it was rewritten
kp.skill.show.not_found: Skill %q not found. /skill list shows what is installed.
kp.skill.tool.unavailable: Skill session controls are not available in this session.
kp.skill.tool.pinned: Skill %q pinned: it is injected into every turn of this session until unpinned.
kp.skill.tool.pin_manual_only: Skill %q is manual-only (disable-model-invocation) and cannot be pinned; the user can run it with /%[1]s.
kp.skill.tool.not_pinned: Skill %q is not pinned — nothing changed.
kp.skill.tool.install_is_users: Installing is the user's decision: suggest /skill install <name> — this tool cannot install.
kp.session.tool.status_bound: Bound to saved session %q (%d messages in this conversation); every turn is written through to it.
kp.session.tool.status_unbound: This conversation is not bound to a saved session. save {name} or attach {name} binds it.
kp.session.tool.status_surface: The session binding is managed by this surface (MCP, ACP or gateway), not by the @session tool.
kp.session.transcript.bad_number: %q is not a positive number. Usage: /session transcript show <from> [count]
